CustomField.formula:
IF( NOT( OR( Record_Type_Name__c = "Student", Record_Type_Name__c = "Guardian" ) ), "",
IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Active_Enrollments__c)), Active_Enrollments__c > 0 ), "Post-Application",
IF( OR( ISBLANK(Application_Count__c), Application_Count__c = 0 ), "Not Started",
IF( AND( Application_Count__c > 0, OR( ISBLANK(Post_Draft_Application_Count__c), Post_Draft_Application_Count__c = 0 ) ), "In Progress",
IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Post_Draft_Application_Count__c)), Post_Draft_Application_Count__c > 0 ), "Applicant", "Not Started" ) ) ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatically identifies the applicant lifecycle stage for Student and Guardian accounts based on related applications and active enrollments: Not Started (no applications), In Progress (application started but still in draft), Applicant (application progressed beyond draft), or Post-Application (has an active enrollment)
CustomField.label: Applicant Lifecycle Status
